snippet.title: Animal Crossing Deluxe - Preview Trailer
snippet.description:
Short preview trailer for the in progress mod Animal Crossing Deluxe!

Animal Crossing Deluxe is a mod for the GameCube version of Animal Crossing powered by the Animal Crossing Decompilation project. It adds tons of quality of life features, regional content, content from future games, and custom content! Currently in development. Check out early patches and keep up to date on it by joining the Animal Crossing modding Discord!

Animal Crossing Modding Discord: https://discord.gg/HcpymVA

Thanks to @yourpalfox for making this F3 trailer! Might be revised before the submission!
